config.err.recent_backup: check recentDecisions (0-20) and backupKeep (1 or more)
config.err.save_similar_min: saveSimilarMin is a number above 0 and at most 1 (the save similarity score a memory needs to count as similar when saving): %v
config.err.recall_min_score: recallMinScore is a number above 0 and at most 1 (the find score a memory needs to enter the request recall): %v
config.err.recall_min_coverage: recallMinCoverage is a number above 0 and at most 1 (the share of the request's meaningful words a memory needs to enter the request recall): %v
config.err.recall_min_relative: recallMinRelative is a number above 0 and at most 1 (the share of the best find score a memory needs to stay in the request recall): %v
config.err.recall_min_coverage_one_word: recallMinCoverageOneWord is a number above 0 and at most 1 (the share of the request's meaningful words a memory needs to enter the request recall when only one of them matched it): %v
config.err.task_recall_min_score: taskRecallMinScore is a number above 0 and at most 1 (the find score a memory needs to enter the recall of a delegated task): %v
config.err.task_recall_min_words: taskRecallMinWords is a whole number from 1 to %d (how many content words of a delegated task, less imperative endings, heading words and item numbers, a memory must match to enter its recall): %v
config.err.task_recall_min_relative: taskRecallMinRelative is a number above 0 and at most 1 (the share of the best find score a memory needs to stay in the recall of a delegated task): %v
config.err.host_timeout: hostTimeouts.%s is a positive Go duration such as "1.5s": %q
